description.text: Program Description Immunology is a biomedical science that studies the immune response of organisms to antigens and its methods. Immune response is the body's response to antigen stimulation, and it is also a biological process to identify and eliminate antigens.Future Career Students can work to aquatic product department commonly, also can undertake scientific research work to the department such as ocean, shipping, light industry, foreign trade, environmental protection, also can choose this respect project to undertake operation.Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Immunology at Shandong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5000 USD/per year ￥ 36000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5. Health certificate(optional)Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation lettersFrom professor,associate professor or equivalents.7. Application Essay 800 words or so in Chinese, regarding major of application and desired direction of study

requirements.text: 1.No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport with good health.2.Applicants should own bachelor degree in concerned subjects or above.
